facts: A unified variational formulation is proposed.
A unified variational formulation is for joint motion estimation and segmentation.
A unified variational formulation includes explicit occlusion handling.
A multi-label representation of the flow field is used.
Each label corresponds to a parametric representation of the motion.
A convex formulation of the multi-label Potts model is used.
The multi-label Potts model includes label costs.
The asymmetric map-uniqueness criterion can be integrated into a formulation.
The asymmetric map-uniqueness criterion is integrated by means of convex constraints.
Explicit occlusion handling eliminates errors otherwise created by the regularization.
Occlusions can occur only at object boundaries.
A large number of objects may be required.
A fast primal-dual algorithm is used.
Several hundred motion segments can be handled.
Results are shown on several classical motion segmentation and optical flow examples.
entities: multi-label representation of the flow field
